This game was my first experience of a metroidvania, but it did an incredible job introducing me to the genre! The lore is absolutely captivating to follow, the combat feels rhythmic and fun, where dying to a boss is a learning experience that gives you more knowledge for next time. Exploring the beautiful world is always a treat, and at first I didn't enjoy the backtracking, but it eventually became so much fun getting to visit new areas and reminisce on places that I had to pass through quickly earlier.

Absolutely amazing experience that encourages me to play Silksong as well, so long as I don't have to do another pantheon of hallownest.
